---
name: New scenario / feature request
about: Request support for a real-life scenario or a new capability
title: "[Feature] Short description"
labels: ["enhancement", "triage"]
---

### What problem are you trying to solve
(Describe a real scenario from everyday life — the more specific, the better.
E.g. "My balcony drying rack is holding 3 wet quilts and I'm afraid it might
break — can it actually bear the load?")

### Expected feature
(How would you like the app to help you solve this problem?)

### Solver type involved
- [ ] 2D beam/truss frame
- [ ] 3D space frame
- [ ] 3D solid (box / plate / cylinder)
- [ ] Thermal / time-history
- [ ] Wind load / overturning
- [ ] Seepage
- [ ] Other: ______

### References (optional)
- Photos of the real object or a sketch with dimensions
- Known materials and loads
- Reference results from other tools or hand calculations (for cross-checking)

### Priority (your judgment)
- [ ] Critical — the app is unusable without it
- [ ] Nice to have
- [ ] Just a bonus
